name: Power of the Pyramid (Thaumaturgical Rituals, Intermediate)

system.description: Standing hand-in-hand in a circle and chanting in unison, a group of Tremere who all know and cast this ritual simultaneously may freely share Willpower Traits among themselves for the ritual's duration. A single participant may break from the circle to cast another ritual or act freely while still drawing on the group's pooled Willpower, but if any other participant loses physical contact, the whole ritual ends. This rite functions only for Kindred of Tremere lineage.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
